products.body_html: # Foam Cutting Pen 1. Fast heating for easy operation 2. Cut foam blocks from any angle to shape as needed 3. Smooth, rapid cutting; clean sealed edges without debris 4. Ergonomic non-slip handle for comfortable, stable grip 5. Ideal for cutting, carving and lettering on polystyrene foam ## Specifications Material: Nickel-Chromium Alloy Room temp resistance: 20 Ohms Max working temperature: 1500°C Application: Insulation foam cutting ## Important Notes 1. Pen tip length may slightly differ due to production batches. 2. Single continuous working time ≤30 mins; cumulative usage ≤2–3 hours. 3. Heating tube can only be bent ONCE; repeated bending at the same spot causes breakage. 4. Only suitable for medium & low-density foam; NOT for high-density foam or mass production cutting. 5. Switch off power after use to extend service life. 6. Items undergo power test before delivery; minor foam residues on pen body are normal. 7. Different-length heating pens cannot be mixed with mismatched power adapters, which leads to failure to heat or burnout. 8. For long-hour heavy work, select desktop foam cutting machine instead. ### Power Supply Comparison - Electronic Transformer: Low cost, lightweight and portable. Vulnerable to voltage surges, higher environmental requirements. - Full Copper Linear Transformer: Highly durable, only likely damaged by overload, but higher cost. ### Foam Cutting Pen VS Desktop Cutting Machine **Foam Cutting Pen** Portable; short single operation time; flexible hand shaping for right-angle corners. **Desktop Cutting Machine** High power, replaceable heating wire, low long-term cost and fast cutting. Introductions:Elevate your daily beauty routine with our all-in-one 9-Drawer 2-Tier Shelf Vanity Desk Set, now featuring a 3-in-1 tabletop organizer grid and a premium combination cabinet. This thoughtfully designed dressing station isn't just a mirror and a table—it's a complete storage ecosystem that tames clutter while adding a warm, modern aesthetic to any bedroom or walk-in closet. The integrated three-tone dimmable light bulb lets you switch between cool, warm, and natural daylight tones, so you always have the perfect lighting for makeup application or skincare layering. Crafted from durable particleboard with a scratch-resistant melamine-faced linen texture, this vanity resists stains and wipes clean in seconds. Whether you're a busy professional or a beauty enthusiast, this set turns your daily primping into a spa-like, organized ritual. Features:
  1. Superior Material & Durability – Constructed from high-density particleboard and finished with a textured melamine-faced linen surface, this vanity set offers exceptional resistance to scratches, moisture, and daily wear. The non-porous coating also prevents makeup spills and perfume stains from soaking in, ensuring your vanity stays pristine for years with just a quick wipe.
  1. Intelligent Storage Design – Featuring nine spacious drawers, a two-tier open shelf, and a detachable 3-compartment desktop organizer grid, this set provides dedicated spaces for palettes, brushes, skincare bottles, and jewelry. The combination cabinet further hides away larger items like hair tools or backup supplies, keeping your working surface completely clear and distraction-free.
  1. Versatile Beauty & Work Uses – Beyond makeup application, this vanity doubles as a compact workstation for laptop writing, a jewelry display station, or a grooming hub for the whole family. The adjustable shelf heights accommodate tall toner bottles or small decor plants, while the sturdy tabletop supports up to 50 lbs of daily essentials without wobbling or sagging.
  1. Customizable Three-Tone Lighting – The included dimmable LED bulb offers three distinct color temperatures—cool white for detail work, warm yellow for relaxing evenings, and natural daylight for true-color blending. This adaptive lighting eliminates harsh shadows on your face, so you achieve flawless foundation matching and eyeliner precision regardless of the time of day or room brightness.
  1. Perfect for Any Space & Routine – Ideal for master bedrooms, rental apartments, dorm rooms, or boutique dressing areas, this compact yet expansive set fits snugly against walls or inside walk-in closets. The neutral linen finish complements both minimalistic and bohemian decor, while the integrated power-cord management notch keeps chargers and styling tools neatly tucked away during your morning or nightly skincare regimen.

products.title: 9.8 FT Lighted Christmas Inflatable Decoration, Large Inflatable Lying Snowman, Funny Blow Up Yard Decorations with Built-in LED Lights for Holiday Party Front Yard Lawn Garden Decor
products.body_html:
Introductions:
Create a magical holiday atmosphere with this eye-catching Christmas inflatable decoration. Perfect for adding festive charm to your yard, garden, or indoor space, this inflatable is sure to impress guests and passersby alike. Designed to capture the spirit of the season, it brings joy and warmth to any holiday celebration, making it an essential part of your Christmas décor. Easy to set up and built to last, this decoration will be a cherished addition to your holiday traditions for years to come.

Features:
1. Eye-catching Design: Transform your yard into a winter wonderland with this funny blow up decoration. Featuring a large snowman lying down, holding a drink and playfully winking, this inflatable will be the star of your indoor or outdoor display and a fantastic photo backdrop for capturing holiday memories.
2. Bright LED Lights: With built-in LEDs, this inflatable decoration will brighten up your holiday nights and make your yard truly stand out. These soft, glowing lights will create a warm and festive ambiance and illuminate your yard.
3. Easy Setup and Storage: Simply zip up the inflatable and plug it into any standard power outlet; the built-in blower will automatically inflate the archway in seconds. When the festivities are over, deflate it just as easily, fold it up, and store it compactly until next year. Includes ground stakes and securing ropes to keep it stable.
4. Durable and Weather-Resistant: Crafted from high-quality, waterproof polyester, this blow up decoration is designed to last through many holiday seasons. The material resists tears and fading, while reinforced stitching prevents leaks, ensuring that your inflatable remains in perfect condition year after year.
5. Versatile Holiday Decoration: Whether placed in the front yard, at a store entrance, or as part of an indoor display, this large Christmas blow up decoration will captivate everyone's attention, ensuring your decorations are the talk of the season.

Specifications:
1. Material: Polyester, Plastic
2. Dimensions: 118 in x 33.5 in x 5.9 ft (L x W x H)
3. Number of LEDs: 5

Package Includes:
1 x Christmas Inflatable Decoration with Adapter and Built-in Fan
1 x Set of Ground Stakes and Securing Ropes
